queue_definition: 67 include-for-abstract-review plus 12 uncertain title-screened records from the 194-record phase-2 backlog
limitations: All 79 received assistant abstract first-pass screening; root checked metadata and selected abstracts/scope assignments, not an independent expert dual screen of every abstract.
Remaining assistant-only model/endpoint snippets are screening context, not curated experimental data.
Two publication versions are grouped with journal records; one link is bibliographic rather than registry-confirmed.
This queue is a selected discovery backlog, not an exhaustive systematic search or retraction/patent clearance.
